notes: The page was last updated in March 2025. Confirm the age range and orientation dates by email. Volunteers cannot lead story times.
name: Alexandria Library Teen Volunteers and Teen Advisory Group
what_you_do: Help at library branches. You set up for programs, help with computers and clean up. The Teen Advisory Group meets to plan teen library events. It counts toward service hours.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 12 to 18 can apply to volunteer. The Teen Advisory Group is for ages 14 to 18.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Service hours can be earned.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Teen Volunteer Application online. Go to a Teen Volunteer Orientation. The dates are on the library events page. Use an email that is not from your school. You can write to volunteer@alexlibraryva.org.
